speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is where Monday left the matter. I am not putting it to the notch again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once was the measure. A thumb short, and a penny, and a threat about Michaelmas. I have not mixed them.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I did not take the thrum out. The knot is still the knot. I am not asking for a second lesson.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. A house can survive one lesson in a week. Eat, and leave the board unmeasured.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eating. Nothing under the line upstairs. Tomorrow is not the night for it either. Friday is the feast on the sheet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will not trim a fresh candle for a page you are not writing. Supper is the work.
